reference_commit: cesm3.0-alphabranch cmeps checkout + fork branch instrument/cmeps-dumps (EqESM-cesm-cmeps bb957c8, cmeps submodule d81b5cc1; earlier pointer 735eb8b with submodule bd88a843; ocnalb/merge dump instrumentation: EqESM-cesm-cmeps 43ccf07 with cmeps submodule cb613113)
description: CMEPS atmosphere-ocean bulk-flux boundary traces from an instrumented C_JRA_t62 (DATM+MOM6) CESM run (PLAN.md CMEPS lane): the full flux_atmOcn_large chain of cesm/flux_atmocn/flux_atmocn_Large.F90 (Large & Pond / Large & Yeager scheme as configured in nuopc.runconfig: add_gusts=.false., coldair_outbreak_mod=.false., aofluxes_use_shr_wv_sat=.true., minwind=0.5 m/s, flux_convergence=0.01, flux_max_iteration=5), one row per traced ocean point per coupling step. Columns: the 12 raw inputs (zbot, ubot, vbot, thbot, qbot, rainc, rbot, tbot, pslv, us, vs, ts), the derived inputs (vmag, wind0, ugust, esat, qsat, ssq, delt, delq, alz, cp), the neutral first estimates (stable0, rdn0, rhn0, ren0), the exit state of the stability iteration (iter, hol, stable, xsq, xqq, psimh, psixh, rd, u10n, rdn, rhn, ren, rh, re, ustar, tstar, qstar), the fluxes (tau, taux, tauy, sen, lat, lwup, evap) and the 2-m/10-m diagnostics (hol2, xsq2, xqq2, psix2, fac_t, fac_q, tref, qref, duu10n, u10res), plus the point metadata (n local ogrid index on PET 0, gid global element index, lat/lon). Extended with two more phase traces of the same instrumented run: cmeps_ocnalb.csv (the med_phases_ocnalb_run ocean-albedo phase: orbital inputs/outputs, albedo settings, rlat/rlon/cosz, the FBFrac fractions ifrac/ofrac/ifrad/ofrad and the four albedos anidr/avsdr/anidf/avsdf) and cmeps_merge.csv (the med_phases_prep_ocn_accum ocn-export merges plus the med_phases_prep_ocn_custom shortwave computation: the merge inputs, the derived fswabsv/fswabsi and scaled fractions, the 13 merged outputs and the 4 shortwave bands).

regenerate.note: Fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-cmeps (branch instrument/cmeps-dumps, cmeps submodule on instrument/cmeps-dumps), CIME scripts from the pristine checkout stage1/cesm/cime. The dump is gated by the mediator attribute dump_cmeps (default .false., set in user_nl_cpl), writes PET 0 only, and traces for the first dump_first_steps coupling steps; CSV lands in stage1/dumps/cmeps/ (dump_dir in user_nl_cpl) under the name dump_file (default cmeps_aoflux.csv). The ocnalb/merge traces are gated by dump_ocnalb/dump_merge (default .false.) with dump_file_ocnalb/dump_file_merge names and the same dump_first_steps; their traced cells come from the trace2 selection (med_dump_select2: the fixed dump_first_cells window unioned with the per-step partial-ice cells 0 < ifrac < 1, capped at dump_first_cells extras, sorted by n - in this run all 12 window cells are partial-ice, so the traced set is the fixed 12 every step). The ocnalb phase dumps inside its albedo loop (the phase copies ifrac/ofrac into ifrad/ofrad AFTER the loop, so the dumped ifrad/ofrad lag one step: ifrad(k) = ifrac(k-1)); the merge writer runs after prep_ocn_custom and recomputes the derived columns (fswabsv/fswabsi, scaled fractions, Foxx_swnet) from the dumped inputs with the custom expressions. Traced cells: either the first dump_first_cells masked ocean cells (fixed mode) or, when dump_stable_cells + dump_wind_cells > 0 (dynamic mode), the per-step union of the dump_stable_cells most-stable cells (delt = thbot - ts > 0) and the dump_wind_cells strongest-wind cells (relative wind sqrt((ubot-us)^2+(vbot-vs)^2)) of ALL masked PET-0 cells, deduped and sorted by local index (med_dump_mod.F90 med_dump_select; reads the raw aoflux inputs only, so it is solution-neutral). user_nl_mom carries AUTO_MASKTABLE=False to match the reference case (root cause of a MOM6 init FATAL; buildnml regenerates MOM_override during case.build). Floats are written es26.17e3 with subnormals flushed to 0.0 (gfortran es26.17 omits the exponent letter, bugs.md #29); rainc is dumped as 0 on the no-gusts path (the mediator's 1-element dummy allocation is uninitialized, bugs.md #28). Run takes ~8 min wall; ~140 s rebuild per dump-module change. case.submit must be run with SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE/CPU/GPU unset when the submitting shell carries them (srun: mutually exclusive error).

dump_files.cmeps_aoflux.csv: # description + # columns header, then one row per (step, traced cell): step,ymd,tod,n,gid,iter,lat,lon,zbot,ubot,vbot,thbot,qbot,rainc,rbot,tbot,pslv,us,vs,ts,vmag,wind0,ugust,esat,qsat,ssq,delt,delq,alz,cp,stable0,rdn0,rhn0,ren0,hol,stable,xsq,xqq,psimh,psixh,rd,u10n,rdn,rhn,ren,rh,re,ustar,tstar,qstar,tau,taux,tauy,sen,lat,lwup,evap,hol2,xsq2,xqq2,psix2,fac_t,fac_q,tref,qref,duu10n,u10res - inputs and outputs of flux_atmOcn_large (see the # description header for per-column units and F90 line citations); hol/xsq/xqq are the zbot-level pre-2m-rescale values (hol0/xsq0/xqq0 of the instrumentation), hol2/xsq2/xqq2 the 2-m-rescaled diagnostics. Note: 'lat' names both the cell latitude (first occurrence) and the latent-heat flux (second); validators resolve the collision by name
dump_files.cmeps_aoflux_wide.csv: same columns and header conventions as cmeps_aoflux.csv, but the traced cells are selected per coupling step (dynamic mode, dump_stable_cells=8/dump_wind_cells=8): the 8 strongest-wind cells of ALL masked PET-0 cells by relative wind sqrt((ubot-us)^2+(vbot-vs)^2) plus the 8 most-stable cells (delt = thbot - ts > 0), union, deduped, sorted by local index. 192 rows = 8 wind-selected rows x 24 steps (the stable selection found no delt > 0 cell on PET 0 in this window); 9 distinct cells (n 6933, 6934, 7024, 7025, 7026, 7112, 7115, 7116, 7117; gid 41583, 41584, 42124, 42125, 42126, 42662, 42665, 42666, 42667), all ~69 S, a subset of the fixed window's 12 cells (the weakest-wind cells n 7023/7113/7114 never make the top-8). The 12134714 run's wide dump is md5 166a90fcb4462f9426392712d1c4ce4b; its validator stats (iter 2 x126, 3 x57, 4 x9; vmag 0.6304..4.8130; all columns <= 3.4e-15) match the recorded stats of the original wide dump (run 12055973, whose file was overwritten by the later reruns - the equivalence plus the identical restart md5s across runs 12055973/12126699/12127523/12134714 establish the content determinism)
dump_files.cmeps_ocnalb.csv: the med_phases_ocnalb_run ocean-albedo phase (Briegleb et al. (1986) scheme, ocean_albedo_scheme=0), one row per traced ocean point per coupling step: step,ymd,tod,n,gid,lat,lon,nextsw_cday,delta,eccf,eccen,obliqr,lambm0,mvelpp,albdif,albdir,min_albedo,use_min_albedo,use_briegleb,flux_albav,rlat,rlon,cosz,ifrac,ofrac,ifrad,ofrad,anidr,avsdr,anidf,avsdf (31 columns; see the # description header for units and F90 line citations). 288 rows = 12 cells x 24 steps; all rows day-side Briegleb (cosz 0.03600..0.69511, delta -0.40296..-0.40166 rad); the dumped ifrad/ofrad lag ifrac/ofrac by one coupling step (the phase copies the fractions after the albedo loop, ifrad(k) = ifrac(k-1), verified on all 288 rows); orbit fixed at orb_iyear=2000 (eccen 0.0167036603927656034, obliqr 0.409101122579778931 rad, lambm0 -0.0324724956615293284 rad, mvelpp 4.93745779048815780 rad), nextsw_cday 1.04166666666666674..2.0 day
dump_files.cmeps_merge.csv: the med_phases_prep_ocn_accum ocn-export merges plus the med_phases_prep_ocn_custom shortwave computation, one row per traced ocean point per coupling step AFTER the merges and the custom computation: step,ymd,tod,n,gid,lat,lon,ifrac,ofrac,ifrad,ofrad, the 9 atm inputs (Faxa_rainc/rainl/snowc/snowl/lwdn/swvdr/swvdf/swndr/swndf), the 5 aoflux inputs (Faox_lwup/sen/taux/tauy/evap), the 6 ice imports (Fioi_taux/tauy/melth/meltw/salt/swpen, dump labels with _ice suffix), the 2 runoff inputs (Forr_rofl/rofi), the 4 ocean albedos (So_avsdr/avsdf/anidr/anidf of FBMed_ocnalb_o), the derived columns (fswabsv, fswabsi, ifrac_scaled, ofrac_scaled, ifracr_scaled, ofracr_scaled), the 13 merged outputs (Faxa_rain, Faxa_snow, Foxx_lwnet/sen/taux/tauy/evap, Fioi_melth/meltw/salt, Foxx_rofl/rofi, Foxx_swnet) and the 4 shortwave bands (Foxx_swnet_vdr/vdf/idr/idf) - 60 columns; see the # description header for units and F90 line citations. 288 rows = 12 cells x 24 steps; all traced cells partial-ice (ifrac 0.0683..0.6246); the band columns pin the single-precision Fortran literals c1..c4 = 0.285/0.215 (vdr/swnet = 0.28499999642372131 on every row)

traced_domain.cells: fixed dump: first 12 masked ocean cells of PET 0 (dump_first_cells=12): local ogrid indices n 6933..7117, global element ids gid 41583..42667, all ~69 S on the Antarctic coast (PET 0's slice of the tx0.66v1 ocean grid), lon 74.0..77.3 E (ESMF [-360, 0] convention). Wide dump (dynamic mode): per-step union of the 8 strongest-wind cells (relative wind) and the 8 most-stable cells (delt > 0) of ALL masked PET-0 cells, deduped, sorted by n; the stable selection is empty in this window, so 8 wind cells/step from a pool of 9 distinct cells (a subset of the fixed window's 12)
